```{r}
library(terra)
```

```{r}
# =========================
# 2) User config
# =========================
base_dir    <- "C:/git/spatial_SCP_taxonomy/data (do not push)"
spatial_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "spatial")

covariate_path <- file.path(spatial_dir, "covariate_stack_3m_all_with_SR_indices.tif")
chem_csv_path  <- file.path(spatial_dir, "soil_points_corrected_with_locations_and_chem.csv")
tex_shp_path   <- file.path(spatial_dir, "perry_full_locs.shp")
tex_xlsx_path  <- file.path(base_dir, "Soil data", "Surface_texture_Perry.xlsx")

# OUTPUT ROOT (as requested)
out_root <- "C:/git/spatial_SCP_taxonomy/outputs"
out_dir  <- file.path(out_root, "perry_regression_kriging")
png_dir  <- file.path(out_dir, "png_maps")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(png_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# =========================
# 3) Load data
# =========================
covs <- rast(covariate_path)
orig_cov_names <- names(covs)
names(covs) <- make.names(orig_cov_names, unique = TRUE)  # safe names
cov_names <- names(covs)

# Chemical points (CID only)
chem <- read.csv(chem_csv_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  filter(type == "CID")

req_cols <- c("x", "y", "pH.2", "Ca", "K", "Mg", "Mn", "P", "Zn")
missing_req <- setdiff(req_cols, names(chem))
if (length(missing_req) > 0) stop("Missing chemical columns: ", paste(missing_req, collapse = ", "))

chem_sf <- st_as_sf(chem, coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE) %>%
  st_transform(crs(covs))

# Texture points: join Point_ID (shp) to Point (xlsx)
tex_pts <- st_read(tex_shp_path, quiet = TRUE)
tex_tab <- read_excel(tex_xlsx_path)

if (!("Point_ID" %in% names(tex_pts))) stop("Point_ID not found in perry_full_locs.shp")
if (!("Point" %in% names(tex_tab)))   stop("Point not found in Surface_texture_Perry.xlsx")

tex_join <- tex_pts %>%
  mutate(Point_ID_chr = as.character(Point_ID)) %>%
  left_join(tex_tab %>% mutate(Point_chr = as.character(Point)),
            by = c("Point_ID_chr" = "Point_chr")) %>%
  st_transform(crs(covs)) %>%
  mutate(
    lab_sand = as.numeric(lab_sand),
    lab_silt = as.numeric(lab_silt),
    lab_clay = as.numeric(lab_clay),
    lab_texture_class = as.factor(lab_texture_class)
  )

cat("Texture rows:", nrow(tex_join), "\n")

cat(
  "Texture complete rows (sand/silt/clay):",
  tex_join %>% 
    sf::st_drop_geometry() %>% 
    dplyr::summarise(n = sum(complete.cases(lab_sand, lab_silt, lab_clay))) %>% 
    dplyr::pull(n),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
# =========================
# 4) RK function
# =========================
run_rk <- function(points_sf, response_col, cov_rast, out_prefix, out_dir, ntrees = 500) {
  cov_names <- names(cov_rast)

  ex <- extract(cov_rast, vect(points_sf), bind = TRUE) |> as.data.frame()

  missing_cov <- setdiff(cov_names, names(ex))
  if (length(missing_cov) > 0) {
    stop("Missing covariates after extraction: ", paste(missing_cov, collapse = ", "))
  }

  dat <- ex %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(response_col), all_of(cov_names))

  # numeric response for continuous RK
  dat[[response_col]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(dat[[response_col]]))
  dat <- dat[complete.cases(dat[, c(response_col, cov_names)]), ]

  cat(response_col, "valid rows:", nrow(dat), "\n")
  if (nrow(dat) < 20) {
    warning(response_col, ": too few complete points (", nrow(dat), "). Skipping.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  idx <- as.integer(rownames(dat))
  xy <- st_coordinates(points_sf[idx, ])
  dat$x <- xy[,1]
  dat$y <- xy[,2]

  fml <- as.formula(paste(response_col, "~", paste(cov_names, collapse = " + ")))
  rf <- randomForest(fml, data = dat[, c(response_col, cov_names)], ntree = ntrees, importance = TRUE)

  trend_r <- predict(cov_rast, rf, na.rm = TRUE)
  rf_pred_pts <- predict(rf, newdata = dat[, cov_names])
  dat$resid <- dat[[response_col]] - rf_pred_pts

  coordinates(dat) <- ~ x + y
  proj4string(dat) <- CRS(crs(cov_rast, proj = TRUE))

  vgm_fit <- try(autofitVariogram(resid ~ 1, dat), silent = TRUE)

  if (inherits(vgm_fit, "try-error")) {
    rk_r <- trend_r
    krige_var <- trend_r * NA
  } else {
    grd <- as.data.frame(xyFromCell(cov_rast[[1]], 1:ncell(cov_rast[[1]])))
    names(grd) <- c("x", "y")
    coordinates(grd) <- ~ x + y
    gridded(grd) <- TRUE
    proj4string(grd) <- CRS(crs(cov_rast, proj = TRUE))

    kr <- krige(resid ~ 1, dat, grd, model = vgm_fit$var_model)
    kr_df <- as.data.frame(kr)

    kr_resid <- rast(cbind(kr_df$x, kr_df$y, kr_df$var1.pred), type = "xyz", crs = crs(cov_rast))
    kr_var   <- rast(cbind(kr_df$x, kr_df$y, kr_df$var1.var),  type = "xyz", crs = crs(cov_rast))

    kr_resid <- resample(kr_resid, cov_rast[[1]], method = "bilinear")
    kr_var   <- resample(kr_var,   cov_rast[[1]], method = "bilinear")

    rk_r <- trend_r + kr_resid
    krige_var <- kr_var
  }

  writeRaster(rk_r,      file.path(out_dir, paste0(out_prefix, "_RK.tif")),       overwrite = TRUE)
  writeRaster(trend_r,   file.path(out_dir, paste0(out_prefix, "_RFtrend.tif")),  overwrite = TRUE)
  writeRaster(krige_var, file.path(out_dir, paste0(out_prefix, "_krigevar.tif")), overwrite = TRUE)

  invisible(TRUE)
}
```

```{r}
# =========================
# 5) Run chemical RK
# =========================
chem_vars <- c("Mg", "Mn", "P", "K", "Ca", "Zn", "pH.2")
for (v in chem_vars) {
  run_rk(chem_sf, v, covs, paste0("chem_", v), out_dir = out_dir)
}
```

```{r}
# =========================
# 6) Run texture RK (%)
# =========================
run_rk(tex_join, "lab_sand", covs, "texture_Sand", out_dir = out_dir)
run_rk(tex_join, "lab_silt", covs, "texture_Silt", out_dir = out_dir)
run_rk(tex_join, "lab_clay", covs, "texture_Clay", out_dir = out_dir)
```

```{r}
# =========================
# 7) Normalize texture to 100%
# =========================
sand <- rast(file.path(out_dir, "texture_Sand_RK.tif"))
silt <- rast(file.path(out_dir, "texture_Silt_RK.tif"))
clay <- rast(file.path(out_dir, "texture_Clay_RK.tif"))

tex_stack <- c(sand, silt, clay)
names(tex_stack) <- c("Sand", "Silt", "Clay")
tex_stack <- clamp(tex_stack, lower = 0, values = TRUE)

sum_tex <- app(tex_stack, sum, na.rm = TRUE)

sand_n <- (tex_stack$Sand / sum_tex) * 100
silt_n <- (tex_stack$Silt / sum_tex) * 100
clay_n <- (tex_stack$Clay / sum_tex) * 100

sand_n[sum_tex == 0] <- NA
silt_n[sum_tex == 0] <- NA
clay_n[sum_tex == 0] <- NA

tex_norm <- c(sand_n, silt_n, clay_n)
names(tex_norm) <- c("Sand_pct", "Silt_pct", "Clay_pct")

writeRaster(tex_norm, file.path(out_dir, "texture_percent_RK_normalized.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)

sum_check <- app(tex_norm, sum, na.rm = TRUE)
writeRaster(sum_check, file.path(out_dir, "texture_percent_sum_check.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)

plot(tex_norm)
plot(sum_check, main = "Sand+Silt+Clay (should be ~100)")
```

```{r}
# =========================
# 8) Texture class RF map (optional)
# =========================
ex_t <- extract(covs, vect(tex_join), bind = TRUE) |> as.data.frame()

dat_t <- ex_t %>%
  dplyr::select(lab_texture_class, all_of(names(covs))) %>%
  mutate(lab_texture_class = as.factor(lab_texture_class)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(lab_texture_class))

dat_t <- dat_t[complete.cases(dat_t[, c("lab_texture_class", names(covs))]), ]

if (nrow(dat_t) >= 20 && nlevels(dat_t$lab_texture_class) >= 2) {
  rf_cls <- randomForest(lab_texture_class ~ ., data = dat_t[, c("lab_texture_class", names(covs))], ntree = 500)

  cls_r <- predict(covs, rf_cls, type = "response", na.rm = TRUE)
  writeRaster(cls_r, file.path(out_dir, "texture_class_RFclass.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)

  prob_r <- predict(covs, rf_cls, type = "prob", na.rm = TRUE)
  writeRaster(prob_r, file.path(out_dir, "texture_class_RFprobabilities.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
}
```

```{r}
# =========================
# 9) Export quick PNG maps (terra plot -> PNG)
# =========================
rk_files <- list.files(out_dir, pattern = "_RK\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)

for (f in rk_files) {
  nm <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))
  png(file.path(png_dir, paste0(nm, ".png")), width = 2000, height = 1400, res = 200)
  plot(rast(f), main = nm)
  dev.off()
}

# Uncertainty example
if (file.exists(file.path(out_dir, "chem_Mg_krigevar.tif"))) {
  png(file.path(png_dir, "chem_Mg_krigevar.png"), width = 2000, height = 1400, res = 200)
  plot(rast(file.path(out_dir, "chem_Mg_krigevar.tif")), main = "chem_Mg_krigevar")
  dev.off()
}

cat("Done. Outputs in:\n", out_dir, "\n")
cat("PNG maps in:\n", png_dir, "\n")
```

```{r}
#visualize all maps in session:
#| label: visualize-all-outputs
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(terra)

out_dir <- "C:/git/spatial_SCP_taxonomy/outputs/perry_regression_kriging"
png_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "png_maps")
dir.create(png_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---------- helper ----------
save_plot_png <- function(r, title_txt, file_png, colr = hcl.colors(24, "Viridis")) {
  png(file_png, width = 2200, height = 1600, res = 220)
  plot(r, main = title_txt, col = colr)
  dev.off()
}

# ---------- 1) RK prediction maps ----------
rk_files <- list.files(out_dir, pattern = "_RK\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)
if (length(rk_files) > 0) {
  for (f in rk_files) {
    r  <- rast(f)
    nm <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))
    plot(r, main = nm, col = hcl.colors(24, "Viridis"))
    save_plot_png(r, nm, file.path(png_dir, paste0(nm, ".png")), colr = hcl.colors(24, "Viridis"))
  }
} else {
  message("No *_RK.tif files found.")
}

# ---------- 2) Kriging variance maps ----------
kv_files <- list.files(out_dir, pattern = "_krigevar\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)
if (length(kv_files) > 0) {
  for (f in kv_files) {
    r  <- rast(f)
    nm <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))
    plot(r, main = nm, col = hcl.colors(24, "YlOrRd"))
    save_plot_png(r, nm, file.path(png_dir, paste0(nm, ".png")), colr = hcl.colors(24, "YlOrRd"))
  }
} else {
  message("No *_krigevar.tif files found.")
}

# ---------- 3) Texture normalized % ----------
tex_norm_path <- file.path(out_dir, "texture_percent_RK_normalized.tif")
if (file.exists(tex_norm_path)) {
  tex_norm <- rast(tex_norm_path)   # Sand_pct, Silt_pct, Clay_pct
  plot(tex_norm, col = hcl.colors(24, "YlOrBr"))
  
  # also save each layer
  for (i in 1:nlyr(tex_norm)) {
    nm <- names(tex_norm)[i]
    save_plot_png(tex_norm[[i]], nm,
                  file.path(png_dir, paste0("texture_", nm, ".png")),
                  colr = hcl.colors(24, "YlOrBr"))
  }
} else {
  message("texture_percent_RK_normalized.tif not found.")
}

# ---------- 4) Texture sum-check ----------
sum_check_path <- file.path(out_dir, "texture_percent_sum_check.tif")
if (file.exists(sum_check_path)) {
  sc <- rast(sum_check_path)
  plot(sc, main = "Texture % Sum Check (should be ~100)", col = hcl.colors(24, "RdYlBu"))
  save_plot_png(sc, "Texture % Sum Check (should be ~100)",
                file.path(png_dir, "texture_percent_sum_check.png"),
                colr = hcl.colors(24, "RdYlBu"))
} else {
  message("texture_percent_sum_check.tif not found.")
}

cat("Visualization done.\nPNG maps saved to:\n", png_dir, "\n")
```
